classification: prospective scenario assumptions; no observed bank staff, budget or signed resource order

months.setup: explicit finite prelaunch schedule, separately reported; real go-live after readiness

other_role_supply: No infinite supply: each candidate must submit finite role/person/month block maxima, qualified independent assignment and ready date; scenario admission conditional on funded bookings accepted before offers. Same menu for all concepts.
funding: separate operating budget prerequisite; not M05 procurement cash, not C/R tokens and not cancelled employee rights
no_double_count: Used reserve work is part of activity labor demand: full resource=priced activity work+paid idle reserved capacity, not activity work plus same used reserve twice. Cash pays all booked hours once; 25pct substitution must not re-price already paid reserve a second time.
rights: If capacity/readiness not funded before a new offer, no new unsupported promise; existing conditional/earned rights, U, orders and original dates remain reserved and restored.
